approved_proposals.context_before:
CHOOSING AN AUTHENTIC PATH

“To thine own self be true.” — William Shakespeare
Life is full of pivotal decisions that significantly influence our trajectory.
Often, we find ourselves at crossroads, choosing between a prescribed path
and an authentic one revealed through deep introspection or powerful
experiences. Recognizing and acting upon these moments is crucial for
personal growth.
